title: 第161章 饲养黑魔法师黄阶极品观想法第160章 地龙血池的神奇效用饲养芭蕉精大丰收
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
;;
【黄阶上品·血元丹丹方】
【以修士自身精血为药引，辅以灵兽血髓、阳属性灵药、五行矿炼制。】
【服用后可补充气血，淬炼血液，提升肉身恢复速度。】
【所需药材：精血......】
苏辰迅速扫过所需药材上记载的材料，眉头微微一挑。
里面的药材完全没有固定，只要药性相近，彼此不会产生冲突，便能用其他材料替换。
苏辰在脑海中推演片刻，眼睛逐渐亮了起来。
火羽鸡返还的四样材料，完全能用在血元丹上。
只要再找到剩下几味主药，便可以尝试开炉炼制。
但可惜的是，药材品质略微低了一点，要是在高一些，黄阶中下品血元丹都可以炼制出来。
苏辰脸上露出笑意。
黄阶极品丹炉。
黄阶上品丹方。
再加上已经凑齐大半的辅材。
前面几次看似毫无关联的返还，如今正好连到了一起。
苏辰将丹方领悟后，目光落到最后五枚青翠种子上。
【黄阶下品·青灵果种子】
【成熟后可凝聚草木生机，用于恢复伤势，也可作为养血类丹药的材料。】
苏辰抬手一挥，将五枚种子种在芭蕉林边缘。

此地灵气充裕，又有芭蕉精汇聚草木之气，正适合青灵果生长。
苏辰收起丹炉和丹方，转身前往鬼类栖息地。
刚刚踏入此地，周围温度便迅速下降。
来到黑魔法师旁边，发现对方的魂体已经恢复了不少。
胸腹间那些狰狞裂口虽然没有完全愈合，却已不再向外溢散魂光。
感应到苏辰靠近，黑魔法师立刻从阴雾中走出，单膝跪下。
“见过主人。”
经过一天的恢复，他已经明白鬼类栖息地的价值。
只要继续留在这里，残破的魂体早晚能够恢复，甚至还有更进一步的可能。
曾经那点不甘，也早已消失得干干净净。
苏辰微微颔首，看向饲养面板。
【饲养物：黑魔法师】
【品质：蓝色】
【所属栏位：鬼】
【忠诚度：70】
【当前状态：饥饿】
【饲养冷却：已结束】
【适合投喂：养阴丹、养魂类灵物、魂力、阴气、怨气、煞气、阴属性灵药、鬼器残片、阴魂类材料】
......
倒计时已经归零。

可以投喂了。
content_en:
;;
[Huangjie Top Grade·Xue Yuan Dan Recipe]
[Using the monk's own essence and blood as the medicine, it is supplemented by the blood marrow of spiritual beasts, yang elixirs, and five elements minerals for refining. 】
[After taking it, it can replenish qi and blood, temper the blood, and improve the recovery speed of the physical body. 】
[Medicals required: Essence and blood...]
Su Chen quickly scanned the materials recorded on the required medicinal materials and raised his eyebrows slightly.
The medicinal materials inside are not fixed at all. As long as the medicinal properties are similar and will not conflict with each other, they can be replaced with other materials.
Su Chen deduced it in his mind for a moment, and his eyes gradually lit up.
The four materials returned by Fire Feather Chicken can be used in the Blood Yuan Dan.
As long as you find a few remaining main ingredients, you can try to open a furnace to refine it.
But it is a pity that the quality of the medicinal materials is a little low. If it were higher, the middle and lower-grade Blood Yuandan of the Huang rank could be refined.
Su Chen had a smile on his face.
Huang Jie's top-quality elixir furnace.
Huang Jie's top-grade elixir recipe.
In addition, most of the auxiliary materials have been collected.
The previous seemingly unrelated returns are now connected together.
After Su Chen understood the elixir recipe, his eyes fell on the last five green seeds.
[Low grade yellow grade·Qingling fruit seeds]
[When mature, it can condense the vitality of vegetation and be used to restore injuries. It can also be used as a material for blood-nourishing elixirs. 】
Su Chen raised his hand and planted five seeds on the edge of the banana forest.
This place is rich in spiritual energy, and the plantain essence gathers the energy of vegetation, which is suitable for the growth of Qingling Fruit.
Su Chen put away the alchemy furnace and alchemy prescription, turned around and headed to the ghost habitat.
As soon as I stepped into this place, the surrounding temperature dropped rapidly.
When he came to the side of the black magician, he found that his soul had recovered a lot.
Although those ferocious cracks between the chest and abdomen have not completely healed, they no longer let out soul light.
Sensing Su Chen's approach, the black magician immediately walked out of the mist and knelt down on one knee.
"Meet the master."
After a day of recovery, he already understood the value of a ghost habitat.
As long as you continue to stay here, your broken soul will be able to recover sooner or later, and there is even a possibility of going further.
The reluctance I once had has long since disappeared.
Su Chen nodded slightly and looked at the feeding panel.
[Feed: Black Magician]
[Quality: blue]
[Official column: ghost]
【Loyalty: 70】
[Current status: Hungry]
[Feeding Cooldown: Ended]
[Suitable for feeding: Yin-nourishing elixirs, soul-nourishing spiritual objects, soul power, yin energy, resentment, evil spirits, yin-attribute elixirs, ghost weapon fragments, and ghost-like materials]
...
The countdown has reached zero.
It’s ready for feeding.
